title: B-cell ELISpot assay to analyze human memory B cell and plasmablast responses specific to SARS-CoV-2 receptor-binding domain
protocol: Coat ELISpot plate with anti-human-IgG.
Block the ELISpot plate with R10 medium.
Aliquot 6 × 10^5 PBMCs from a suspension of 2 × 10^6 cells/mL into an Eppendorf tube (Tube A).
Prepare a new tube with 656 μL of R10 medium (Tube B).
Transfer 10 μL from Tube A to Tube B.
Dilute the PBMCs in Tube B for the “Total IgG” condition.
Plate cells into ELISpot plate.
Remove blocking medium from the ELISpot plate.
Fill each well with fresh R10 medium, adjusting volume based on conditions.
Add 50 μL of PBMC suspension (Tube A) to wells for the "RBD" condition (containing 1 × 10^5 cells).
Add 200 μL of diluted PBMCs from Tube B to additional wells for the "Total IgG" condition.
Do not let the membrane of the well dry during the procedure.
Plate the highest concentration of the “RBD” condition (200 μl) first since there is no R10 added.
Wrap the plate in aluminum foil to limit evaporation and incubate at 37°C–5% CO2 for 18–24 h.
Do not move the plate during the incubation to avoid shifting of the cells in the well.
Take out PBMCs: aliquot 2 × 10^6 cells in an Eppendorf tube from the 2 × 10^6 cells/mL PBMCs suspension.
Prepare 1 ml of stimulation medium for each sample.
Add R848 at a final concentration of 1 μg/ml.
Add IL-2 at a final concentration of 10 ng/ml.
Resuspend PBMCs in the stimulation medium.
Centrifuge down the PBMCs at 500 × g for 5 min at 18°C–22°C.
Discard the supernatant and add 1 mL of stimulation medium.
Transfer into one well of a 48-wells plate and incubate for 5 days.
Do not use edge wells on the plate; fill empty wells with sterile water to limit evaporation.
Check the culture after 2–3 days, add fresh medium if some wells turned yellow.
Collect and count the stimulated cells at day 6.
Collect the cells from the 48-wells plate and transfer into Eppendorf tubes.
Centrifuge down the cells at 500 × g for 5 min at 18°C–22°C.
Discard supernatant (Optional: collect the supernatant in new tubes to analyze antibodies secreted by stimulated B cells).
Resuspend cells in 200 μL of R10 medium.
Take out 10 μL of cells and mix with 40 μL of methylene blue (dilution 1:5).
Count nucleated cells using the diluted sample.
Resuspend the cells at 2 × 10^6 cells/mL in R10 medium.
Prepare a suspension corresponding to Tube A (“RBD” condition) with 5.5 × 10^5 cells.
Dilute cells for the “Total IgG” condition by transferring 10 μL from Tube A into a new tube containing 656 μL of R10 (Tube B).
Plate the cells as described in step 3 and Figure 2.
Prepare detection reagents: Anti-IgG-biotin at a final concentration of 1 μg/mL in PBS 1× for 100 μL/well.
Dilute RBD-WASP in PBS 1× at a 1/25 dilution for 100 μL/well.
Prepare Streptavidin-ALP in PBS 1× at a 1/1000 dilution for 100 μL/well.
Dilute Anti-WASP-ALP in PBS 1× at a 1/275 dilution for 100 μL/well.
Keep diluted reagents on ice until use.
Flick the plate upside down over a waste container.
Wash the plate with 200 μL of PBS 1× per well for a total of 4 times.
Use a pipette to flush up and down in each well for the first wash.
Flick the plate upside down for the following washes.
Place the plate under UV for 5 min to decontaminate the wells (optional).
Protect unused wells from UV with aluminum foil.
Remove PBS before adding detection reagents.
Add 100 μL of detection reagents and incubate 2 h at 18°C–22°C.
Wash the plate 4 times with 200 μL of PBS 1×.
Add 100 μL of detection reagents (step B) in each well and incubate 1 h at 18°C–22°C.
Wash the plate 4 times with 200 μL of PBS 1×.
Filter the BCIP/NBT-plus substrate before usage.
Add 100 μL of filtered BCIP/NBT-plus substrate in each well.
Protect from light to prevent affecting spots development.
Incubate 4–5 minutes.
Stop the reaction by adding 250 μL of distilled water.
Wash the plate 4 times with 200 μL of distilled water.
Optional: Add 200 μL of Virkon-S disinfectant to decontaminate the wells (only for acute samples).
Incubate 5 minutes after adding disinfectant.
Wash the plate 4 additional times with 200 μL of distilled water.
Remove the plastic rubber bottom from the plate.
Let the plate dry at 18°C–22°C before reading.
Shake the plate upside down on a tissue between each washing step to remove excess liquid.
Select all wells from the “Total IgG” condition.
Choose “tiny” emphasis for the selected wells.
Adjust intensity to 80-90 based on spot development.
Select all wells from the “RBD” condition.
Choose “big” emphasis for the selected wells.
Adjust intensity to 10-20 based on spot development.
